content.text: Spring Break 2026 Dates by School | Your Ultimate Guide Spring Break 2026 runs from March 2 – March 30, 2026, depending on your school. From the University of Florida to Stanford and CPS, find your dates below — and plan your Cancun, Cabo, or Miami trip with Go Blue Tours. 👉 View the full list of Spring Break dates by school here. When is Spring Break 2026 in the USA? Most U.S. colleges and schools will have spring break between March 2–March 30, 2026, with peak travel weeks in mid-March. 👉 Looking for your exact school? See our complete spreadsheet here: When Is My Spring Break? Why Knowing Spring Break Dates Matters ✈️ Flights and hotels sell out months ahead of peak weeks. 🏖️ Cancun, Cabo, and South Padre hit capacity during SEC + Big Ten breaks. 📅 Booking early means better pricing, availability, and VIP access to nightlife events.
